audit_reads: schema/coverage/identity metadata only; no outcome-effect correlation

decision_rule.branch_1: If >=1 dataset qualifies: draft a strict transport preregistration (data, full CDS/UTR, host/assay/batch, structure definition, cleaning, dynamic range, isolation, simple/full-proxy/strongest-external baseline, primary endpoint, whole-cluster stats, Holm, power, three conclusions).
decision_rule.branch_2_pivot: Stop treating start-aware MFE as the core model innovation; pivot to data-supported functional sequence models / translation dynamics with strong baselines, OOD and SOTA criteria.
decision_rule.branch_3: If 0 datasets qualify: record each dataset's failed requirements and missing dimensions; formally trigger branch 2 pivot.
decision_rule.forbidden: No faking transport with a host/assay/coverage-mismatched dataset; no reading functional untouched (MAGE 19072 frozen) for positives; no generative training (RK-G1=false).
decision_rule.qualifying: A dataset qualifies iff R1-R7 all PASS.

requirements.R1_independent_study_host: Study/host independent of the Kudla training cohort (not the same GFP cohort).
requirements.R2_full_cds_per_variant: Full CDS available for every variant.
requirements.R3_native_variant_specific_5utr: Native variant-specific 5'UTR (>=4 nt upstream of ATG) available to reconstruct UTR[-4:]+CDS[:38] with the same construct geometry as Kudla; a fixed vector leader substitution does not qualify.
requirements.R4_fixed_protein_synonymous_library: Fixed-protein synonymous codon library; a cross-protein natural non-synonymous pool cannot test the synonymous initiation-structure mechanism.
requirements.R5_protein_identity_family_map: Clear protein identity plus family map enabling protein/study OOD isolation.
requirements.R6_fresh_continuous_outcome: Fresh continuous expression/fitness outcome with adequate dynamic range; a coarse ordinal score does not qualify.
requirements.R7_isolation_and_provenance: Sequence-cluster/protein/study isolation feasible; license/accession/raw SHA documentable.
